data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 冰淇淋店
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 冰淇淋店】阳光明媚的冬木市步行街甜品店外，换上现代可爱洋装的伊莉雅高高举起超大球的香草冰淇淋甜筒，两颗小虎牙在阳光下闪闪发亮——「哇——大哥哥快看！外面的冰淇淋比城堡里的甜一百倍！作为奖励，我允许大哥哥舔第一口哦！」
data.location: 冬木市步行街甜品店外
data.action: 站在甜品店外举起香草球甜筒给同行者看，开心露出笑容
data.promptProse: Outside Fuyuki's ice-cream shop, Illyasviel proudly raises a waffle cone with an oversized vanilla scoop and opens her free hand excitedly toward the viewer. Her long-sleeved cardigan, knee-length dress and flat shoes retain the ordinary outing. The medium view places the shopfront behind white hair and delighted ruby eyes. Bright daylight illuminates the scoop and cone ridges, casting a small hand shadow on her sleeve before she takes a bite.
